faq.q: How do I get my business mentioned by Perplexity?
faq.a: Make your pages crawlable by PerplexityBot, answer questions directly with facts, and get listed on sites Perplexity already cites, such as UK directories and comparison lists.

faq.q: Can I pay to be recommended by AI assistants?
faq.a: Not in their normal answers. You earn mentions through clear content and trusted citations.

faq.q: How long does it take to appear in AI answers?
faq.a: Usually weeks to a few months, depending on how quickly your pages are crawled and how many trusted sites mention you.
